Spare blankets, a brief notice midweek
We write to travelers

Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers with companion animals should review their travel details with care and share concerns with the desk as early as possible. Aurelia Skyways is committed to calm, respectful service, and we will continue to guide each traveler through the steps that support a safe journey for both passenger and pet.

Please keep transport documents, carrier details, and basic care notes ready for review. Clear and prompt communication helps us respond properly when plans change or when a traveler needs extra support. If a concern is raised, our supervisors listen closely and work with the traveler to find the best practical path forward.

Our team handles routine checks, booking support, and follow-up for companion animal travel throughout the week. We ask travelers to remain courteous in all contact with the desk, as this helps us maintain steady service for everyone. If you are preparing to travel with a pet, the desk can help you understand the next steps and keep the process orderly.

For guidance and assistance, please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
